title: Day 1: Introduction to Lists and List Operations
description: Master the fundamentals of Python lists: sequence container characteristics, zero-based and negative indexing, slicing, mutability, dynamic modifications (append, insert, extend, pop, remove, del), and traversal.
topics: Introduction to Lists: Containers, Sequences & Characteristics
Creating Lists: Heterogeneous Types & Empty Initializations
List Indexing: Positive (0 to N-1) and Negative (-1 to -N)
List Slicing: Bounds, Steps, and Reversals
List Mutability: In-Place Modification & Slice Assignment
Adding Elements: append(), insert(), and extend()
Removing Elements: remove(), pop(), and del
Membership & Length: in, not in, and len()
List Traversal: Direct, Index-Based, and enumerate()
